subject: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Turner <mike.turner@spectra-sys.com>, Alice Ng <alice.ng@spectra-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems

Hi Mike / Alice —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery so we can align on budget/next steps: 

What we heard:
- Expected usage: conversational assistant + batch summarization across product and support — rough ballpark today: 20M–30M input+output tokens / month.
- Main objective: reduce latency for customer-facing flows while keeping unit economics manageable.
- Procurement note: anything over $20k/month requires VP procurement approval and a PO; multi-year commitments need legal to review MSA/SOW redlines.

Budget / unit economics questions we wanted to validate:
1) Target $/1M tokens you'd be comfortable with (ballpark).
2) Preferred monthly spend band (e.g., < $10k, $10k–$50k, $50k–$150k, $150k+).
3) Any procurement thresholds or billing/PO constraints we should design around (invoice terms / net days / consolidation across org).

To help the conversation, I attached a quick pricing estimate (redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx) that shows three tiers: a self-serve hosted price, a committed volume discount, and a dedicated reserved option.

Proposed next steps:
- If you can confirm the three items above, I'll produce two concrete pricing options (hosted tier with volume discount vs 12-month commit for dedicated capacity) and a one-page procurement checklist so your procurement team can validate timelines.
- Optional: 30-min procurement sync with your procurement manager + our finance lead.

Thanks — looking forward to your numbers.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (Excel)

From: Mike Turner <mike.turner@spectra-sys.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Ng <alice.ng@spectra-sys.com>, Spectra Systems Procurement <procurement@spectra-sys.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems

Thanks Aditya — good recap. A few clarifications from our side after the call: 

- Estimated monthly tokens: ~25M tokens/month (we see variation month-to-month; planning on a baseline of 20M with spikes to ~30M).
- Target unit economics: our finance lead is looking for a target around $900 / 1M tokens (that gets us into the budget range our leadership prefers).
- Preferred monthly spend band: $15k–$30k/month. That aligns with the token estimate above at the $900 target.
- Procurement thresholds: anything over $20k/month requires VP procurement approval + a formal PO. For multi-year or committed deals, Legal will want to review the MSA/SOW. Timeline: decision by ~2026-04-02; PO expected by ~2026-04-15 if pricing aligns.

I’m attaching our standard SOW template so you can see procurement's formatting expectations.

Mike
Director, Platform Engineering
Spectra Systems

Attachment: SOW-template.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-03-18T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems

Aditya — forwarding Mike's reply into thread. Quick internal take: 

- They're at ~25M/mo and targeting $900 / 1M tokens => ~$22.5k/mo. Procurement flag at $20k/mo (VP approval required).
- Recommended response: propose two commercial paths:
  1) Hosted / volume-tier pricing: entry discount but likely around $1,000–$1,150 / 1M without commit — helpful for them to start quickly and keep flexibility.
  2) Committed 12-month contract (reserved capacity or committed spend) to get to $800–$900 / 1M depending on minimums and billing terms.

Action: If you can propose a clean option that meets their procurement threshold (i.e., shows a scenario right at/just below $20k and a committed option at ~$22k) we can move to procurement sync. I’ll loop in finance if we need to approve a one-time credit to hit the threshold.

-Marissa
Account Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Turner <mike.turner@spectra-sys.com>, Alice Ng <alice.ng@spectra-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Spectra Systems

Mike / Alice — thanks for the quick clarification and procurement note. Based on the numbers you shared, we can propose two practical options for your procurement and finance teams to evaluate: 

Option A — Fast start (hosted, invoice):
- Tiered hosted pricing with volume bands; estimated blended price for 25M tokens: $1,100 / 1M tokens (no long-term commit).
- Estimated monthly: 25 * $1,100 = $27,500 (this is above your $20k VP threshold).
- Billing: net 30, invoices, PO OK. No dedicated SLA.

Option B — Committed (12-month) — best for unit economics:
- 12-month committed spend with a minimum of 20M tokens/month. Unit price: $850 / 1M tokens (final price tied to commitment level).
- Estimated monthly at baseline 25M: 25 * $850 = $21,250 (just above the $20k threshold but within your VP approval band).
- Includes reserved capacity benefits (lower tail latency) and an SLA.

Notes & next steps:
- If the primary blocker is the $20k/month VP approval, we can: 1) tweak the committed minimum to 23M on a 12-month term to bring estimate closer to $19.5k, or 2) offer a one-time onboarding credit (I’ve asked finance for pre-approval) to get your first 1–2 months under the threshold while keeping committed pricing thereafter.
- I attached a simple two-option estimate (20260318-spectra-pricing-options.xlsx) so procurement can see numbers side-by-side.
- Proposed next step: 30-min procurement sync week of 2026-03-29 to confirm PO timeline and any legal/MSA asks.

Please confirm which option you prefer or if you want us to model a 24M/23M committed minimum to hit specific approval gates. Happy to jump on a call with procurement.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: 20260318-spectra-pricing-options.xlsx (Excel)
